chat_previewPagesEyebrow.zh: Shared in chat · 开发预览

chat_previewPagesMessage.en: Demo prices and facts aren't provider responses. In production, cards without fresh facts don't show price, Buy or Watch.
chat_previewPagesMessage.zh: 演示价格和事实不是 provider 响应。生产卡片缺少新鲜事实时不会显示价格、Buy 或 Watch。

chat_previewPagesMessage2.en: Reference price, 24h change, and volume are labelled Demo data. Opening Market loads a separate current public Spot snapshot.
chat_previewPagesMessage2.zh: Reference price, 24h change, and volume are labelled 演示数据. Opening Market loads a separate current public Spot snapshot.

chat_previewPagesSubtitle.en: Development preview: messages only store the asset ID; current price and facts are re-verified when shown.
chat_previewPagesSubtitle.zh: 开发预览：消息只保存资产标识；当前价格与事实必须在展示时重新验证。

chat_secondaryPagesS.en: Removed from Development preview only. No sender interaction occurred.
chat_secondaryPagesS.zh: Removed from 开发预览 only. No sender interaction occurred.

chat_secondaryPagesShowRequestNotice.en: Marked accepted in Development preview and removed locally. No Stream conversation was created.
chat_secondaryPagesShowRequestNotice.zh: Marked accepted in 开发预览 and removed locally. No Stream conversation was created.

chat_secondaryPagesShowRequestNotice2.en: Removed from Development preview. No report was submitted.
chat_secondaryPagesShowRequestNotice2.zh: Removed from 开发预览. No report was submitted.

chat_secondaryPagesTitle.zh: Development Preview only · 开发预览

chat_streamInboxBody.en: The conversation is removed from the list and comes back when there's a new message. Chat history isn't cleared.
chat_streamInboxBody.zh: 会话会从列表移除，有新消息时会重新出现。聊天记录不会被清除。

chat_streamInboxChatVoiceRoomReturnEntry.en: In voice room, {communityName}, return to room

chat_streamInboxMessage.en: This build isn't connected to the chat service, so conversations won't show here.
chat_streamInboxMessage.zh: 这个版本没有连接聊天服务，会话不会显示在这里。

chat_streamInboxMessage10.en: Before resolving a LOOP group, we need to confirm you're still a member of this group chat.
chat_streamInboxMessage10.zh: 解析 LOOP 群组前，需要先确认你当前仍是这个群聊的成员。

chat_streamInboxMessage11.en: LOOP is confirming you're a member of this group chat.
chat_streamInboxMessage11.zh: LOOP 正在确认你是这个群聊的成员。

chat_streamInboxMessage12.en: Couldn't confirm your membership in this group chat. No group was resolved.
chat_streamInboxMessage12.zh: 没有确认到你在这个群聊里的成员身份，没有解析任何群组。

chat_streamInboxMessage13.en: LOOP is confirming this channel and your membership.
chat_streamInboxMessage13.zh: LOOP 正在确认这个频道和你的成员身份。

chat_streamInboxMessage14.en: Couldn't confirm your membership in this channel. No channel was created or opened.
chat_streamInboxMessage14.zh: 没有确认到你在这个频道里的成员身份，没有创建或打开任何频道。

chat_streamInboxMessage2.en: Couldn't restore the conversation. No message action was taken on this page.
chat_streamInboxMessage2.zh: 会话没有恢复成功，这一页没有执行任何消息操作。

chat_streamInboxMessage3.en: The chat service isn't connected yet. Try again later.
chat_streamInboxMessage3.zh: 聊天服务还没有连接，稍后再试。

chat_streamInboxMessage4.en: This link doesn't point to a conversation LOOP supports. No channel was opened.
chat_streamInboxMessage4.zh: 这个链接没有指向 LOOP 支持的会话，没有打开任何频道。

chat_streamInboxMessage5.en: LOOP is restoring the server-authorized chat connection.
chat_streamInboxMessage5.zh: LOOP 正在恢复由服务端授权的聊天连接。

chat_streamInboxMessage6.en: Couldn't restore chat authorization. No conversation was opened.
chat_streamInboxMessage6.zh: 聊天授权没有恢复成功，没有打开任何会话。

chat_streamInboxMessage7.en: Opening this conversation needs a server-confirmed chat identity and a short-lived token.
chat_streamInboxMessage7.zh: 打开这个会话前，需要服务端确认的聊天身份和短期凭证。

chat_streamInboxMessage8.en: This link doesn't point to a group chat LOOP supports. No group was resolved.
chat_streamInboxMessage8.zh: 这个链接没有指向 LOOP 支持的群聊，没有解析任何群组。

chat_streamInboxMessage9.en: Couldn't restore chat authorization. No group was resolved.
chat_streamInboxMessage9.zh: 聊天授权没有恢复成功，没有解析任何群组。

chat_streamInboxStreamChatListErrorMessa.en: Couldn't load the conversation list on this page. Local history wasn't deleted.
chat_streamInboxStreamChatListErrorMessa.zh: 这一页没有读到会话列表，本地已有的历史没有被删除。
